Method of Attack: Phishing attack using Microsoft Edge WebView2 applications to steal authentication cookies
Injecting JavaScript into embedded WebView2 browser to log keystrokes and steal cookies
Exporting authentication cookies via WebView2 'ICoreWebView2CookieManager' interface and sending them to attacker-controlled server
Stealing cookies from existing Chrome user profiles by using their Chromium User Data Folder
Bypassing multi-factor authentication by using stolen cookies to authenticate sessions
Attack Vector: Social engineering to convince user to run malicious WebView2 executable
Indicators of Compromise: Base64-encoded stolen authentication cookies sent to attacker-controlled server
